description: Gold query set for the embedding-model comparison harness (roadmap #27, analysis/embedding_compare.py). Each entry pairs a natural-language query with the slug(s) of the corpus article(s) that most directly answer it, so a candidate embedder can be scored on precision@k / recall@k / MRR against the pinned sbert-mpnet-v2 (decision D2). This file is text-free (queries + public article slugs only), so it is committed like eval/questions.json. Validate it offline with `make embedding-queries-check` (every relevant_slug must resolve to a slug in data/manifest.json). Expand it (more queries, more relevant_slugs per query) to tighten the comparison.

queries.query: Is Europe finally moving toward a shared fiscal union, a Hamiltonian moment?
What is Warren Buffett's bet on the Japanese trading houses, and does value investing still work?
Why did China block Jack Ma's Ant Group IPO?
What drove the GameStop short squeeze and the gamma swarm?
Is the recent inflation spike real or just a statistical artifact in the CPI?
What is the CHIPS Act and is it really necessary for U.S. semiconductor competitiveness?
Does raising the Fed funds rate actually tame inflation, and what is the collateral damage?
Will Trump's tariffs cause a recession?
Is cryptocurrency mostly a fantasy, and how should we think about its ethics?
Did Beijing manipulate or underreport China's COVID death data?
Is Alibaba a value play or a value trap after Beijing's crackdown?
Did adding Tesla to the S&P 500 create a bubble?
Is China's economy heading into a Japan-style stagnation?
